description: Two exact semantic probes for the surface_collection controls.

mutants.test_filter: SurfaceCollection groups surfaces by every merge property
mutants.description: Grouping only by SurfaceType merges surfaces that differ in thickness, layer count, or bridge angle; the returned group boundaries and member pointers must distinguish all three fields.

mutants.test_filter: SurfaceCollection simplify preserves surface metadata and holes
mutants.description: Constructing a fresh Surface for each simplified polygon drops thickness, layer count, bridge angle, and extra perimeters from the originating surface.
